product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill uses AI agents to help candidates find jobs and employers recruit talent, directly introducing them when there is a suitable match.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Jack as an AI career agent, Jill as an AI hiring agent, and their joint role in directly introducing matched candidates and companies. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists free candidate access and employer plans, including Hire Jill from $199 per active role per month. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Fyxer and Maze appear in the customer logo area of the company's pricing page. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us | named_customers.0: Fyxer appears on the customer logo wall. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us | named_customers.1: Maze appears on the customer logo wall. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/pricing/us

employee_band.notes: The company states that it has 28 people, which falls within 21–50. This explicit company statement is preferred over the conflicting LinkedIn-associated profile count. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's own job posting explicitly states that it is headquartered in London. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/050c78ca-62c8-44c0-ac3d-925b7a8a8aa3 | hq_country: The company's community-lead posting identifies London as headquarters, and its careers listings identify the location as London, UK. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/050c78ca-62c8-44c0-ac3d-925b7a8a8aa3 and https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 2025 as its founding year. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/jackandjillai

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents product announcements, AI-sourcing commentary, hiring advice and team-building content, rather than at least two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links several distinct product guides, including Who is Jill?, The Hiring Brief and Pipeline Management. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/docs

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company's open-role list includes engineering, design, operations, finance, community and Account Executive positions, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Founding Engineer and GTM Engineer do not meet the specified title criteria. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us

model_provider.notes: TypeSafe AI's case study includes a quotation attributed to Jack & Jill's CEO and states that Jev was deployed in production, replacing Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for a candidate-matching stage. Source: https://typesafe.ai/blog/jack-jill-jev-case-study

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The privacy policy explicitly recognizes UK GDPR rights and commits to responding to rights requests. GDPR is reported as a public compliance commitment, not a formal certification; no claim of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI DSS was found. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/privacy | compliance_certs.0: The policy names UK GDPR and commits to handling the rights it provides; this is a compliance commitment rather than a formal certification. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/privacy

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding announcement explicitly identifies the round as Series A. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a | funding_date: The $40 million Series A announcement is dated 15 September 2026, yielding 2026-09. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a | funding_amount_usd: The company's latest funding announcement states that it raised a $40 million Series A. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a

raised_18mo.notes: The $40 million Series A announced on 15 September 2026 falls within the preceding 18 months. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/series-a

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive (SF) posting includes an application link. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/2fd5e1c5-9f09-4d69-89eb-839393beaf68

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced the launch of Company Insights in Jill on 4 November 2026, within the preceding six months. Source: https://www.jackandjill.ai/blog/company-insights

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ben Slater's profile lists his Jack & Jill VP Marketing role as starting in October 2026, within the preceding 12 months. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/ben-slater-96298367

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable GTM Engineer and Account Executive postings discuss commercial systems, outbound work and automation but name no CRM or sales/marketing platform. General website analytics and tools mentioned in customer-company job listings were not treated as Jack & Jill's CRM stack. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/b7e19764-25b8-465e-8a41-206ea821ef28 and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/jack-jill-external-ats/2fd5e1c5-9f09-4d69-89eb-839393beaf68
